title: CNMD - Junction schema
description: A junction in a drinking water supply network, aligned with FIWARE Smart Data Models and INSPIRE.

addressLocality.description: The locality, which must correspond to the municipality

addressRegion.description: The NUTS 2 region in which the locality is located

district.description: The administrative district in which the locality is located

type.description: Property. NGSI entity type. It must be Junction.

chlorinationPoint.description: Property. Location where disinfectants are injected into the water supply. Relevant for 'potableWater' system junctions. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'.

anyOf.description: Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity

connectedPipes.description: Relationship. Pipes connected to the junction.

criticalInfrastructure.description: Property. Specifies whether the junction is critical infrastructure. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'.

currentFlow.description: Property. Real-time or recently measured flow passing through the junction. Units:'MQS'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

datasetResponsibleParty.description: Property. Party responsible for the dataset. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

dimension.description: Property. Dimensions of the junction, including diameter or measurements for non-circular shapes. Units:'MMT'. For circular junctions, define diameter; for others, define length and width. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

disinfectantResidual.description: Property. Residual disinfectant concentration (e.g. chlorine, chloramine). Units:'MG/L'. Relevant for 'potableWater' system junctions. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

elevation.description: Property. Elevation of the point where the junction is located. Units:'MTR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

hasAirReleaseValve.description: Property. Specifies whether the junction has an air release valve. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'.

hasBackflowPrevention.description: Property. Specifies whether there is a mechanism preventing backflow of contaminated water into the main network. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'.

hasInspectionHatch.description: Property. Specifies whether the junction has an inspection hatch. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'.

hasValveChamber.description: Property. Specifies whether the junction has a valve chamber. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'.

image.description: Property. Images of the junction. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'.

incomingFlows.description: Relationship. Pipes bringing flow into the junction.

installationDate.description: Property. Installation date of the junction. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'.

junctionFunction.description: Property. Function of the junction. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

lastInspectionDate.description: Property. Date of the last inspection. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'.

lastCleaningDate.description: Property. Date of the last cleaning. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'.

license.description: Property. License associated with the data. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'.

anyOf.description: Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity

maintainer.description: Relationship. Party responsible for the maintenance of the junction.

material.description: Property. Construction material of the junction structure. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

materialClass.description: Property. Classification of the junction material. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

operatingPressure.description: Property. Pressure at the junction. Units:'BAR'. Relevant for 'potableWater', 'irrigation', 'industrialWater' system junctions. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

outgoingFlows.description: Relationship. Pipes taking flow out of the junction.

pressureClass.description: Property. Pressure resistance class of the junction's construction (design-level property). Model:'ISO2531:2009 & EN 805:2025'.

quality.description: Property. Observed quality of the network component, where 5 is excellent. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

refNetwork.description: Relationship. Unique code identifying the network to which the component belongs.

restrictedAccess.description: Property. Specifies whether access to the junction is restricted. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'.

slope.description: Property. Slope of the junction relative to the horizontal plane, relevant to hydraulic behaviour. Units:'DEG'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

status.description: Property. Operational status of the junction. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

updateFrequency.description: Property. Frequency at which the data is updated. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

version.description: Property. Version of the data model. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.
